notes: This focused trace separates the standard-MIM switch update from the public C++ getter used to observe it. It verifies NO_ACTION and DELETE_OBJECTS values and restores the starting directive; it does not exercise resignation side effects or claim complete automatic-resignation conformance.

requirements.statement: The standard federate-level HLAsetSwitches interaction permits a joined federate to send individual declared parameters; HLAautomaticResignAction sets that federate's automatic-resign action using the HLAresignAction enumeration represented by HLAinteger32BE.
The public API returns the joined federate's current ResignAction directive; the test verifies the getter after each standard-MIM update and after restoring the observed initial value.
